title: TRICARE Prime Point-of-Service Option: Deductible and Cost Share
content:
For **TRICARE Prime** tiers that have the point-of-service option, non-emergency care that required a referral and was received without one - no approved referral authorization for the patient whose servicing provider and validity span cover the line's provider and service date - is paid under the point-of-service option.

## Condition

Point-of-service charges apply only to a line whose service class is not one of the tier's exempt classes and that no approved referral covers. The evidence is the patient's referral authorizations on file (their status, servicing provider and validity span), read before the line is adjudicated.

- Care from the enrollee's own PCM never triggers point-of-service charges.
- Active duty service members have no point-of-service option; their unreferred civilian care is reviewed by the military medical support office and is not cost-shared to the member.

## Charges under point-of-service

1. The line first applies to the point-of-service deductible until the beneficiary has met the individual point-of-service deductible or the family has met the family point-of-service deductible for the plan year. The part of a line applied to the deductible is never more than the line's allowed amount.
2. The beneficiary then pays the tier's point-of-service cost-share percentage of the remaining allowed amount, that is, of the allowed amount less the part applied to the deductible.
3. The line's cost share is the part applied to the deductible plus that percentage share, rounded to the cent.
4. Point-of-service charges never count toward the catastrophic cap and are never stopped by it.

The deductible already met is the total applied to the point-of-service deductible on the beneficiary's (and, for the family figure, the sponsor family's) Prime claim lines with service dates in the calendar plan year containing the line's service date, less the deductible withdrawn by reversals of those lines.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Option available | Individual deductible (USD per plan year) | Family deductible (USD per plan year) | Cost share after the deductible | Counts toward the catastrophic cap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 percent | no |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member | no | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 percent | no |
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member | yes | 300.00 | 600.00 | 50 percent | no |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member | yes | 300.00 | 600.00 | 50 percent | no |
| TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor | yes | 300.00 | 600.00 | 50 percent | no |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A | yes | 300.00 | 600.00 | 50 percent | no |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B | yes | 300.00 | 600.00 | 50 percent | no |

Every tier lists the same classes that never trigger point-of-service charges: preventive care, emergency room visits, urgent care visits and individual outpatient behavioral health visits.

## Worked line (hypothetical)

A TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A enrollee sees a specialist without a referral; the allowed amount is 400.00, the enrollee has 100.00 applied to the deductible this plan year and the family 100.00 in all.

| Step | Amount |
|---|---|
| Deductible still open for the beneficiary (300.00 less 100.00) | 200.00 |
| Applied to the deductible (not more than the 400.00 allowed) | 200.00 |
| Remaining allowed amount (400.00 less 200.00) | 200.00 |
| 50 percent of the remaining allowed amount | 100.00 |
| Cost share on the line (200.00 plus 100.00) | 300.00 |
